notes.title: Turbo Boom! Now Unbanned from Germany
notes.content:
Hello Drivers,

The team received a few incident reports about drivers being unable to wishlist the game due to a regional ban! After appealing to the race stewards, the issue has been resolved Turbo Boom! is now wishlist-able in Germany.

Of course the issue was paperwork required for ratings and approvals, but with that sorted everything is good to go and waiting for race day. For the fastest updates on Turbo Boom!, you can [url=https://www.twitch.tv/timbeaudet]watch the development process live![/url]

notes.title: Get Ready for Explosive Racing: Turbo Boom! Demo is Coming to Steam!
notes.content:
Hello Drivers,

After waiting in the garage like most project cars work is resuming to bring a Turbo Boom! demo to Steam! Before the rally car is ready to hit the track we need to give it a tune-up. The tires need to be kicked, the engine needs an oil-change and the dashboard gauges need to be recalibrated.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36722747/5fa596dfffc566b171634e579df71972ef173aea.png[/img]

Wishlist today for future updates and prepare to beat your friends by sliding around explosives!
